name: Vehicle VisualAssetRegistry
purpose: Versioned registry for source hero, generated transition, exploded, hotspot and fallback assets.
implementation_note: Asset manifest with per-file SHA-256 written at 16_PACKAGE. Versioned registry across visual families is not yet built.

name: Visual Equivalence Group
purpose: Map multiple trims/variants to one visual body representation when body differences are immaterial.
implementation_note: visualFamilyId and fitmentId are separate identities; parseJob rejects a mapping whose visualFamilyId disagrees.

name: Hero source provenance
purpose: License/source/hash/vehicle binding and approval for every source image.
implementation_note: Licence, SHA-256, magic-byte and decoded-pixel validation at 01_SOURCE_VALIDATE. Approval gates are hash-chained and bound to an authenticated principal. Test proves an unapproved source is blocked before processing. Open-licence acquisition policy (CC0/PDM/CC BY/CC BY-SA, NC and ND rejected) with required landing page, creator attribution and dual human identity/licence approval, and no cross-vehicle asset reuse. Directly serves ACT-REG-011.

name: CGI transformation output contract
purpose: Accept output from specialist generator without making generator catalogue authority.
implementation_note: Generator output is accepted only against a lock derived from the normalized source, so the generator never becomes its own authority. Landmark metrics the deterministic provider cannot compute report NOT_MEASURED rather than 0. Development packs are WAIVED with measured drift recorded; live providers are held to the gate.

name: Hero→exploded transition asset
purpose: Versioned mobile/web animation or scene tied to visual vehicle group.
implementation_note: Explosion planning now meets Blueprint 4.3's minimum record: packages/explosion emits per-group layerAssetId, origin, destination, vector, depth, startProgress, endProgress and easing, staggered so groups overlap. Delivery does not. The pipeline still renders flattened whole-scene frames rather than compositing the named layers, and apps/preview-player/components/dvtg-preview.tsx animates 23 hardcoded CSS clip-path polygons over a single already-exploded still - the exact production method 4.3 prohibits. Nothing emits or asserts the shared display matrix 4.3 requires between artwork and hit map. This capability cannot advance past CODE_PRESENT until the blockers below clear.

blockers.statement: Cropping pieces from an already-exploded still and sliding those crops into view is not an acceptable production method.
blockers.clears_when: The player interpolates separately rendered layer assets (or named meshes) from assembled to exploded transform; no clip-path crop of an exploded still remains.

blockers.statement: The motion engine must produce component or group layers, masks, depth order, origin, destination, vector, timing, and easing. A flattened start image and flattened end image alone are not sufficient for a production flow.
blockers.clears_when: The pipeline renders and packages one asset per layerAssetId in the explosion plan, and QA fails a pack whose plan names a layer with no corresponding asset.

blockers.statement: Apply the exact same final scale, translation, crop, and object-fit matrix to the artwork and its invisible hit map; visual separation must never create interaction drift.
blockers.clears_when: The flow pack declares one display matrix consumed by both the artwork and the hit map, and a coordinate-probe test asserts a click resolves to the same category at desktop and mobile profiles.

name: Exploded category navigation map
purpose: Hotspot/region→DIAL category/assembly binding authored and reviewed, never guessed at runtime.
implementation_note: Hit regions are authored, not guessed at runtime. QA blocks an enabled category with no region and flags equal-priority overlap as ambiguous routing. Route templates carry an explicit hitPriority, which is what makes overlap resolvable rather than ambiguous: QA flags overlap only at equal priority, since Body & Exterior is the fallback layer beneath specific categories.

name: Motion/data-saver fallbacks

implementation_note: prefers-reduced-motion cuts to the stable exploded result, asserted by the Playwright reduced-motion project. Data-saver and weak-network fallbacks are still not implemented.
